title: Offline live-path security, privacy, and supply-chain policy gate

observations.policy: Offline operations are limited to bounded read/edit/test actions; network, credentials, provider, LLM, publication, and durable-state mutation are denied.
observations.supply_chain: Exact dependency versions, manifest/lockfile digests, SPDX SBOM digest, integrity/license digests, signature, and DCO observations are required.
observations.privacy: Only bounded identifiers, enums, booleans, versions, and SHA-256 digests enter public evidence.
observations.evidence: Every component and the exact task/project/worktree/session binding has one canonical digest reference.

failure_semantics.side_effects: No scanner, package manager, signature verifier, network, provider, LLM, Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, UI, Git, or durable-state operation is performed.

limitations: The checker validates supplied observations and does not cryptographically verify signatures, inspect the host, enumerate dependencies, or prove live enforcement.
Local qualification is not hosted-CI, provider, remote, Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, or UI success.
